text:
Cobalt is a typical transition element.
Which statement about cobalt is correct?
A
Cobalt has a low density.
B
Cobalt has a low melting point.
C
Cobalt can form only colourless compounds.
D
Cobalt can act as a catalyst.

options.label: B
options.text: Cobalt has a low melting point.

options.label: C
options.text: Cobalt can form only colourless compounds.

options.label: D
options.text: Cobalt can act as a catalyst.
